title: Phase 2 W4 — 2x6 wall with R-24 fibreglass and 51 mm exterior XPS
jurisdiction: NRC Field Exposure of Walls facility, Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (research specimen; no permit jurisdiction)

facts.text: Phase 2 used a common exterior arrangement including vinyl siding, polymer-based sheathing membrane and 11 mm OSB, with interior 6-mil polyethylene and drywall; the report provides fabrication figures and appendices.
facts.locator: PDF pp. 20–23; report §2.2, Figs. 10–17 and fabrication appendices

facts.text: W4 is a 2x6 R-24 glass-fibre wall with 51 mm exterior XPS (reported overall R-34), within the report’s common Phase 2 exterior/interior layers.
The report’s Phase 2 protocol included a deliberate 3 mm slit and controlled indoor conditions (about 21°C, 50% RH and 10 Pa) during a test period.

The protocol used a deliberate 3 mm air-barrier slit; the report observed condensation in Phase 2 walls under the defect condition, followed by drying during a later period. No project or permit outcome is reported.

limitations: Shared report with cases L18-004–L18-006; each candidate identifies one exact W-series configuration. Results are only for NRC’s test conditions.
